svg.title: SCR01.S0 Ready: service Running; facets independent

g.text: SCR01.S0 · Ready: service Running; facets independent
Service Running (desired running) · MCP ready · ADB offline · view ready · catalog ready · ARC disabled
MCP, ADB, resolved view, catalog, inbound ARC, snapshot revision
Enabled subject to exact local/backend authority gates
Service started only after eligible foreground start and listener ready; Stop closes admission and
Effect: Listener ready; show actual ADB/view/catalog/ARC facets. Start action now means Stop.
Recovery: Stop deliberately or inspect a specific degraded facet; never infer overall readiness.
Modal drawer below840dp; persistent rail at840dp+. Back returns previous detail, with Discard/Stay for dirty
Design only · local control/state contract; no Android implementation or authority granted
